name: PT Petrosea Tbk
summary: PT Petrosea Tbk provides engineering, construction, mining, and other services to the oil and gas, infrastructure, and industrial and manufacturing in Indonesia and internationally. It operates through four segments: Mining, Services, Engineering and Construction, and EPCI-offshore oil and gas. The Mining segment provides mining contract services, including overburden stripping, drilling, blasting, lifting, hauling, mine, and mine partnering services, as well as engages in the sale of coal. The Services segment offers supply base facilities and port services.
